name: Kanzaki Tooru
source:
Likes: Songs, movies (especially horror), Mio
Dislikes: Boys
Favorite food: Anything edible
Disliked food: Nothing

A girl who used to be [url=/c1889]Mio's[/url] classmate when they were young.

[spoiler]Her teacher and classmates bullied her. One day she obtained a special power, which she used to kill those who bullied her.

She tried to blackmail [url=/c38928]Mio[/url] into cooperating with her, but Mio didn't approve of her behavior. Because of this, she made people murder Mio's parents.[/spoiler]
